scope: CM-marked rigidity, compatible rational descent, canonical degree-17 residue frame, and finite higher-jet separation bounds; no independent Shimura evaluation.

sources.title: The Stacks Project, uniqueness of stable models
sources.use: Extends each geometric generic automorphism after a finite extension of the DVR.

sources.title: The Stacks Project, proper Deligne-Mumford stack of stable curves
sources.use: Its diagonal gives a finite unramified automorphism scheme, including residue characteristic 2.

sources.title: The Stacks Project, sections of unramified separated morphisms
sources.use: Sections over a connected base agreeing at one point coincide; proves faithful stable specialization without a prime-to-2 restriction.

sources.title: Lassina Dembélé, A hyperelliptic Shimura quotient of genus 16
sources.use: Canonical Shimura descent and Atkin-Lehner compatibility as reviewed in D58. Reuses the exact invariant-prime/class-group inputs. Not a use of the hyperellipticity theorem.

sources.title: Jeroen Sijsling and John Voight, On explicit descent of marked curves and maps
sources.use: Smooth-source-marked descent used in D58; uniqueness of marked comparison maps implies the Weil cocycle and compatible descent.

sources.title: Raymond van Bommel, Edgar Costa, Bjorn Poonen and Padmavathi Srinivasan, Curve equations from expansions of 1-forms at a nonrational point
locations: Lemma 4.1 and Corollary 4.2, as reviewed in D88
sources.use: Exact degree/order relation criterion. J3 rank refinement is the project's D88 deduction, not an independently provided Shimura evaluator.

prior_exact_inputs: D99 actual simple cubic stable graph and nonhyperellipticity
D105 H0(K-D)=0, all projective frame cofactors nonzero, H of degree 272 and Gaussian projective height bound
D58 geometric marked descent and exact arithmetic prerequisites
D59 proved CM class number and 31-adic Galois group, without numerical root matching
D103-D104 integral adjugate sections, disk norms and intrinsic CM fiber height
D101 first candidate tangent; D88 normalized candidate mod-31 jets and J3 rank
project_deductions: Aut(C_Qbar) embeds in the 64-element graph group; its D-preserving subgroup is trivial by odd orbit, Galois transitivity and projective-frame faithfulness.
The given F-model has unique compatible Q-descent as a D-marked curve, without D56 ordinarity/moments.
Degree-17 residue field is uniquely Q-isomorphic to saved root field; residue frame is rational up to one scalar.
Integral higher Gaussian expressions have lines omega^9*T^6 and omega^15*T^10; Taylor height bounds are 31518 and 52533.
Candidate-only exact jets and independent identities give sufficient prime31 comparison thresholds 3257,9746,16236.
excluded_inferences: No explicit descent matrices or saved numerical CM-point/root matching certificate.
No proof of a particular nonzero actual G12 pivot.
No independent actual Shimura tangent or jet, candidate identification, downstream marking identification or target polynomial.
Finite graph and formal arithmetic audits do not machine-verify the geometric theorems.
